meta.name: slash-command-factory
meta.description: Generate custom Claude Code slash commands through intelligent 5-7 question flow. Creates powerful commands for business research, content analysis, healthcare compliance, API integration, documentation automation, and workflow optimization. Outputs organized commands to generated-commands/ with validation and installation guidance.
